subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking from New York to Los Angeles on June 15th, 2023. Your flight details are as follows: Flight number AB123, departure time 10:00 AM, arrival time 1:00 PM. Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. We hope you have a pleasant journey. Best regards, The Airline Team
